claim: Across tasks and models, intrinsic LLM confidences are poor predictors of code correctness, with ECE ranging 0.09 to 0.73.
stance_target: L1 occupancy: execution-graded calibration of code models
scope_conditions: Sec. I, Table IV; temperature 0; Codex, GPT-3.5, CodeGen2-16B
quoted_support: We observe generally high ECE (Expected Calibration Error, described in Section III-C) across all settings, ranging from 0.09 to 0.73, suggesting intrinsic LLM confidences are poor predictors of code correctness.

breadth.elicitation_formats: token prob, verbalized, reflective logit; few-shot BM25 (Sec. III-B, RQ3)
breadth.benchmarks: HumanEval, MBPP, line-level completion, SStubs, Defects4J (Sec. III-D, Table II)
